stem.en: Which of these best fits the meaning of a city-state?

text.en: A large city with a big temple, ruled from another city

feedback.en: A city-state rules itself. A city ruled from somewhere else is not sovereign, however large it is.

text.en: A sovereign state centred on a city that rules the land around it
Many regions under one family of rulers

feedback.en: That describes an empire, such as the Akkadian one. A city-state is centred on one city.

text.en: A large village that has grown rich through trade

feedback.en: Size and trade are not enough. What makes a city-state is that it governs itself and the land around it.

explanation.en: A city-state has its own government, it is centred on one city, and it rules the territory around that city.

hints.en: Look for the option that says who governs, and over what.
